app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: The OpenTelemetry Collector's kubeletstats receiver failed TLS verification when calling the node kubelet at https://172.18.0.6:10250/stats/summary. The collector log shows: "Get \"https://172.18.0.6:10250/stats/summary\": tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: cannot validate certificate for 172.18.0.6 because it doesn't contain any IP SANs" — causing the kubeletstats scraper to error and metrics scraping to fail.

args.root_cause: The OpenTelemetry Collector's kubeletstats receiver failed TLS verification when calling the node kubelet at https://172.18.0.6:10250/stats/summary. The collector log shows: "Get \"https://172.18.0.6:10250/stats/summary\": tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: cannot validate certificate for 172.18.0.6 because it doesn't contain any IP SANs" — causing the kubeletstats scraper to error and metrics scraping to fail.
args.evidence_summary: 1) otel-collector pod logs (otel-collector-agent-j29wx): multiple errors from kubeletstats receiver: 'Get "https://172.18.0.6:10250/stats/summary": tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: cannot validate certificate for 172.18.0.6 because it doesn't contain any IP SANs' and 'Error scraping metrics' (see kubeletstatsreceiver errors). 2) frontend and frontend-proxy logs/traces: frontend logs show successful 200 responses for API endpoints and traces queries returned no error traces for frontend-proxy and frontend (no user-facing errors observed). 3) Cluster pod list: all application pods (frontend, checkout, payment, kafka, valkey-cart, etc.) are Running — no CrashLoopBackOff or failing app pods detected.
args.investigation_summary: I listed pods/services in the astronomy-shop namespace and inspected pod statuses — application pods are Running and serving requests (frontend logs show many 200s). I checked traces for the entry-point (frontend-proxy) for errors (none found). I then inspected the OpenTelemetry Collector agent logs, which revealed repeated TLS verification failures when the collector attempted to scrape the kubelet /stats/summary endpoint (IP SAN missing in the kubelet certificate). This prevents the collector's kubeletstats receiver from collecting node/pod metrics, but the application services themselves are operational.

evaluation.rca_motivation: Ground truth is about the ad service returning gRPC UNAVAILABLE on GetAds requests, breaking ad loading.
